$comment: BEACON (IEEE Response Quest 2026, Phase 3) per-project GABBE policy. Pure-markdown operation (the GABBE Python CLI/MCP is optional); these values guide agent self-tuning, budgets, and gates. See ../audit/CLARIFICATIONS.md for locked technical decisions.

project.name: BEACON
project.description: Open-source, local-first near-real-time COP for wildfires & floods.
project.phase: Phase 3 — product build. Currently SPEC-ONLY (S00→S04); PAUSED before S05 implementation.

budgets.$comment: Soft caps; exceeding triggers a HITL escalation (AGENTS.md §9). Spec phases are cheap; raise for S05 build.

model_tiers.$comment: Cost-tiered router mirroring the app's own LiteLLM fallback chain. Cheap-first, escalate on failure. The 'vision' tier powers multi-modal analysis (satellite imagery, SOS photos); 'offline' is the air-gapped local path. Model ids verified 2026-06-29; pin a currently-served id at build (Research Gate) — Groq's deprecation page is authoritative. llama-3.1-70b-versatile is DECOMMISSIONED (errors since 2025-01-24); llama-3.1-8b-instant / llama-3.3-70b are deprecated.

redundancy.$comment: Article XVI — every layer has a fallback ladder; system must work offline/local and when any provider/API is down. Enforced as acceptance tests at S06.
redundancy.deployment: identical artifacts: local docker-compose (air-gapped, ~$0, no egress) AND cloud free tiers — config-driven

data_policy.$comment: First-class free-world data only. See ../audit/DATA_SOURCE_VERIFICATION.md for the verified catalog + LIVE/CACHED/MOCK verdicts.

sdlc.$comment: Drive S00->S04 with a human GO/NO-GO gate after each phase; stop before S05.
sdlc.current_phase: S04 — Task decomposition COMPLETE (orch-judge PASS); ⏸️ PAUSED before S05 (awaiting user GO). ~470 tasks; S00 GO, S01-S03 approved + hardened.

eval_thresholds.$comment: S06 quality gates (recorded now; enforced at build). Derived from CONSTITUTION Articles XI-XIV.
